current_evidence: The council's 'Local planning application requirements' page still links this PDF as 'EHDC Local planning application requirements', and a web search found no later EHDC list; the document is dated May 2024, after a consultation from 6 Nov to 17 Dec 2023.

issues.detail: The list date is 2024-04-01, taken from PDF metadata (Date basis 'PDF metadata CreationDate'). The document text dates the list May 2024. The 'Outdated (>2y)?' = Yes flag is still correct, because May 2024 is more than two years before Nov 2026.
No app-type row captures the Accommodation Schedule. It applies to all major residential applications except outline (so Full planning and Reserved matters).
issues.evidence: Accommodation Schedule - 'All major residential applications, except applications for outline planning permission.'

issues.detail: The Annexe Accommodation Statement has no requirement row. It is only a garbled fragment inside a 'Drawing / document standards' tab item. It applies to planning applications for ancillary self-contained accommodation for an existing dwelling, so it should sit under Householder/Full planning.
issues.evidence: 'Applications for planning permission to provide ancillary self-contained accommodation for an existing dwelling.'

issues.detail: Telecommunications Development Statement ('All telecommunications applications'), Agricultural Statement and Structural Survey are only under Full planning, and their triggers are missing or empty. For example, the Structural Survey trigger is just 'Structural Survey When required'. The source's Structural Survey triggers (LBC affecting structural integrity, conversion of rural buildings outside settlement boundary, substantial demolition) are not captured. The Structural Survey is also not under Listed building consent, although the source names LBC explicitly.
issues.evidence: Structural Survey - 'Applications for listed building consent where the proposed works have implications for the structural integrity of the building'; 'conversion of rural buildings outside a settlement boundary'

issues.detail: The Habitats Regulations Assessment trigger omits the separate 5.6km Solent SPA zone. Several HRA/biodiversity rows also have truncated triggers, e.g. the Reserved matters HRA row reads only 'Phase II Special Protection Area for Birds (SPA).'
issues.evidence: HRA - new residential units within '5km of a Special Protection Area (SPA), Special Area of Conservation (SAC) and/or Ramsar' or '5.6 km of the Solent SPA'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are cut off at 'When required i.' and give no threshold. Examples: Full planning Air Quality Assessment ('Air Quality Assessment When required i.'), Noise Impact Assessment, Lighting Assessment, Travel Plan and Town Centre Uses Statement. The source gives precise thresholds, e.g. Air Quality is required for 100+ dwellings, 10,000m2 floorspace, 1,000m2+ B2 or 300+ parking spaces.
issues.evidence: Air Quality Assessment: development of 100+ dwellings or 10,000m2 new floorspace; B2 1,000m2+; over 300 new parking spaces

issues.detail: The 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' triggers are text from other items. Under Full planning the excerpt is Odour Assessment text ('remains, solid waste management, composting ... Chapter 3.1 ... Odour Assessment'). Under Outline and LBC it is 'remains, solid waste management ... Parking provision i.'. The real Refuse Disposal Details trigger is not captured.
issues.evidence: Refuse Disposal Details - 'All new residential, retail, commercial or agricultural development'

issues.detail: Listed building consent has 31 requirements copied from checklist 04, 'Planning and listed building consent', which covers a combined planning + LBC application. The planning-only items are therefore assigned to standalone LBC, e.g. Affordable Housing, Air Quality, BNG, CIL, Contaminated Land, Cycle parking, Nutrient Neutrality, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan and Viability. The LBC-only checklist (08, media/9005) was never read.
issues.evidence: Planning page: '04 Planning and listed building consent checklist' (media/4757) vs '08 Application for listed building consent' (media/9005); docs_read omits 9005

issues.detail: The keyword-matched app types are wrong in several rows: (a) Advertisement consent gets Biodiversity Net Gain because the trigger matched 'press advertisement'; (b) Works to trees gets Retail/Town Centre Impact Assessment; (c) Minerals & waste (county) gets Contaminated Land, although EHDC is not the minerals and waste authority; (d) Change of use - prior approval gets the Sustainability Checklist, although the trigger itself says 'aside from change of use', plus Self-build/CIL relief and the Additional Plans block-plan item, which applies to householder applications and Prior Notification for larger homes, not change of use.
issues.evidence: Advertisement row excerpt: 'press advertisement. 8 Biodiversity Net Gain'; Sustainability Checklist: 'Any application for additional floorspace (i.e. aside from change of use)'

issues.detail: Several Householder rows do not apply to householder applications. (a) BNG: the trigger itself says 'except householder applications'. (b) Contaminated Land: the triggers are >10 dwellings, known contamination, and landfill within 250m for non-householder sites. (c) Gypsy & Traveller information: the excerpt is checklist scope text saying to use the householder checklist instead. (d) HRA: applies to new residential units only.
issues.evidence: Planning page: 'Applications for planning permission (except householder applications) are required to demonstrate 10% biodiversity net gain'

issues.detail: The Outline rows include items from the Reserved Matters checklist (media/4784): Roof plan, Street scene, Existing and proposed site levels, EIA and Landscaping details. Roof plans and detailed elevations are not outline requirements, and outline checklists 05/06 (media/9002, 9003) exist.
issues.evidence: Outline 'Roof plan' row source media/4784 = '12 Approval of reserved matters after outline permission checklist'

issues.detail: The INFERRED placement is used throughout. 27 rows are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', even though the source states the trigger, e.g. Planning Statement (all major), Landscaping Details (major, full only), Viability, Odour and Telecommunications. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is a mislabel: in the source it is part of the Structural Survey information and is not limited to listed buildings.
issues.evidence: Notes: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list; placed under Full planning'

issues.detail: Several 'Submission rules' tab items are process or boilerplate text, not validation requirements: the appeal to PINS after 8/13 weeks, the validation timescales (3-5 days minor, 10 days major), the pre-application advice blurb, the viability publication policy, and a run-on list of page links ('EHDC Local planning application requirements (pdf 426 kb) SDNP Local validation list...').
issues.evidence: 'Normally, most minor and householder applications will be validated within 3 to 5 working days'; 'an applicant can appeal to the Planning Inspectorate (PINS) after 8 or 13 weeks'

issues.detail: Some Policy-driven tab items are context sentences or fragments rather than requirements, e.g. 'Such internationally designated sites include the Wealden Heaths Phase II SPA and the Thames Basin Heaths SPA', 'Nutrient neutrality is achieved when...', and 'Natural England have provided two separate Nutrient Budget Calculators...'. Others start mid-sentence ('5km of a Special Protection Area...').

The Drawing/document standards tab repeats the same scale-bar / OS-licence rule 8 times from different checklists, some of them run together with the next heading ('...scale bar attached to all plans Affordable Housing Statement When required i.'). 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' and 'Sustainability / Climate change checklist' duplicate the same Sustainability Checklist under Full, Outline, LBC and Prior approval.
issues.evidence: tab_items 3-10; app_type_rows Energy/Sustainability vs Sustainability checklist

issues.detail: The workbook does not note that part of the district lies in the South Downs National Park, which has its own Local validation list. Advertisement consent and LBC-only checklists (09, 08) and the planning+LBC checklist (07) are listed on the page but were not used.
issues.evidence: Planning page: 'The South Downs National Park (SDNP) has separate Local Requirements to EHDC.'

summary: Grokbot's link is the council's current list, though the document is dated May 2024 rather than April and is now over two years old. The app-type mapping is unreliable: the combined planning+LBC checklist was treated as LBC-only, keyword matches put BNG under adverts and town-centre tests under tree works, and the Accommodation Schedule and Annexe statement are missing.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
